---
title: "Exponent after an f form"
format:
  pdf:
    include-in-header:
      - ../macros-pdf-header.tex
      - ../macros.qmd
---

An exponent after an f form must rise over a tall argument (the macros#147 brace rule).

```{=latex}
\newsavebox{\withexp}\newsavebox{\withoutexp}
\sbox{\withexp}{$\E{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\E{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt EFRISES\else EFSTUCK\fi
\sbox{\withexp}{$\var{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\var{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt VARRISES\else VARSTUCK\fi
\sbox{\withexp}{$\devsymf{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\devsymf{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt DEVRISES\else DEVSTUCK\fi
\sbox{\withexp}{$\Pf{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\Pf{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt PROBRISES\else PROBSTUCK\fi
\sbox{\withexp}{$\sigmoidf{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\sigmoidf{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt SIGRISES\else SIGSTUCK\fi
\sbox{\withexp}{$\doddsf{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\doddsf{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt DODDSRISES\else DODDSSTUCK\fi
\sbox{\withexp}{$\exp{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\exp{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt EXPFRISES\else EXPFSTUCK\fi
\sbox{\withexp}{$\ndist{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\ndist{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt NDISTRISES\else NDISTSTUCK\fi
\sbox{\withexp}{$\epsp{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\epsp{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt EPSPRISES\else EPSPSTUCK\fi
\sbox{\withexp}{$\indicp{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\indicp{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt INDICPRISES\else INDICPSTUCK\fi
\sbox{\withexp}{$\doddsinvf{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\doddsinvf{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt DODDSINVRISES\else DODDSINVSTUCK\fi
\sbox{\withexp}{$\dinvoddsf{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\dinvoddsf{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt DINVODDSRISES\else DINVODDSSTUCK\fi
```

The rejected form is the control: an unbraced body must not rise, so the test can fail.

```{=latex}
\newcommand{\unbracedcontrol}[1]{\mathrm{P}\paren{#1}}
\sbox{\withexp}{$\unbracedcontrol{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\unbracedcontrol{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt CTRLRISES\else CTRLSTUCK\fi
```
